# Mobility routine

## When
15 minutes after every shift and after every run longer than 10 km. On a yoga mat in front of the TV, otherwise it doesn't happen. Morning stuff is separate ([[朝のヨガ]]).

## The 15 minutes
1. cat-cow × 10, slow
2. 90/90 hip switches × 8 each side, hands off the floor when I can
3. world's greatest stretch × 5 each side (lunge, elbow to instep, rotate)
4. couch stretch against the sofa, 60 s each side. Hip flexors after 12 hours on my feet are concrete
5. calf stretch on the stairs, straight knee 45 s, bent knee 45 s
6. thoracic rotations on the side × 10 each
7. dead hang from the pull-up bar 3 × 20 s, decompresses the back and helps the fingers for [[Climbing finger training]]
8. 2 minutes legs up the wall

## Why these
Pilar picked 1, 2 and 6 for the back ([[Lower back pain]]). Consuelo added the calf and hip flexor ones for the knee. The legs up the wall is just for the vibes and the ankles after a shift.

## Tools
- foam roller, TriggerPoint GRID, $49, quads and IT band before the long run
- lacrosse ball for the glutes and the feet
- massage gun (Theragun Mini) that Dev gave me for my birthday 2025-04-11, mostly for calves

## What changed
Sit and reach went from -6 cm in February 2024 to +4 cm in September 2025. Ankle dorsiflexion knee to wall test: left 9 cm, right 7 cm (the right one is the stiffer side, matches the knee story).
